info.title: Final Fantasy VII: Timeline Analyzer API
info.description: Read-only access to the Timeline Analyzer's dataset: how the 1997 original, Remake, INTERmission and Rebirth present the same events, characters and places. Title codes: `og`, `remake`, `intermission`, `rebirth`.

get.summary: Whether the API and its database are up
Titles, original segments, arcs, eras and worlds
get.description: Everything needed to label and lay out the rest of the data. It changes only when the dataset is redeployed.

coverage.description: The original segments this title retells; null if it retells none.

get.summary: List entities, optionally one kind or only those a title shows
One entity: its appearances in every title, differences and relationships

appearances.description: One per title and world, in release order.

label.description: Read from this entity's side, e.g. `took part in` or `killed by`.

get.summary: Events in in-universe order, with how each title shows them
get.description: Year 0 is the year the main story begins; earlier years are negative. Events sort by (earliest year, seq, id). Only events shown in at least one of `titles` are returned, each with its appearances in those titles.

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

start.description: This title's own time, when it differs.

get.summary: What a title shows, in the order the player sees it
How the chosen titles present one entity, side by side

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

isNew.description: Appears in the Remake series but not in the original.

changed.description: A documented difference targets this title.

differences.description: Only those with both sides among the compared titles.

label.description: Read from this entity's side, e.g. `took part in` or `killed by`.

applicable.description: Compared titles that show both ends of the relationship — the only titles that could establish it.

get.summary: Every documented difference between the chosen titles
get.description: Events come first, in in-universe order; then other entities by name.

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

get.summary: An entity's neighbourhood in the relationship graph
get.description: Every entity within `depth` relationships of `id`, and the relationships among them, following only relationships that one of `titles` establishes.

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

weight.description: Cost in shortest-path search; lower is a stronger link.

get.summary: Find entities by name, summary or connection
get.description: Every word must match the entity's names or aliases (typos tolerated), its summary, how a title presents it, or the name of an entity it's related to. Exact and prefix name matches rank first.

detail.description: The matched name, the title code, or the connected entity's name.
